% A revtex4-2 article with a title, an abstract, and headings of each
% level. tex4ht has no revtex4-2.4ht, so the headings were bold text in
% one paragraph, each with the same id, and the title and abstract
% repeated the ids of revtex4-2's table of contents lines.
\documentclass{revtex4-2}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead title}
\author{Someone}
\begin{abstract}
Text of the abstract.
\end{abstract}
\maketitle
\section{First section}\label{sec:first}
Text of the first section, before section~\ref{sec:math}.
\subsection{A subsection}\label{sec:sub}
Text of the subsection.
\subsubsection{A subsubsection}
Text of the subsubsection.
\paragraph{A paragraph.}
Text of the paragraph.
\section{Mass $m$ and \emph{energy}}\label{sec:math}
Text after math, back to section~\ref{sec:first} and
subsection~\ref{sec:sub}.
\section*{Starred section}
Text of the starred section.
\subsection*{Starred subsection}
Text of the starred subsection.
\subsubsection*{Starred subsubsection}
Text of the starred subsubsection.
\section[Short]{Long title of a section}
Text of the long section.
\begin{acknowledgments}
Text of the acknowledgments.
\end{acknowledgments}
\appendix
\section{Numerical details}
Text of the appendix.
\section*{Unnumbered appendix}
Text of the unnumbered appendix.
\end{document}
